name: @lazyjackorg/bipcircle-verifier
description: Open-source verifier for BIPCircle stablecoin reserve attestations. Re-derives PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE from primary sources (XRPL, bank-service JWKS, on-chain token supply) without trusting BIPCircle or Lazy-Jack infrastructure. Verifies each currency cell against its own reserves — legally segregated cells never net — and binds every verdict to the cell the transaction's own anchored record names.
